zh: 从左往右扫描时，只需要知道目前还有多少个左括号没有被匹配，具体是哪几个并不重要。
遇到右括号时，如果有未匹配的左括号就让它们配对；如果没有，这个右括号无论如何都要在它前面补一个左括号。扫描结束时剩下的每个未匹配左括号都要补一个右括号。
维护 left（未匹配的左括号数）和 missing（需要补的左括号数）：遇到左括号 left 加一；遇到右括号时若 left 大于 0 就减一，否则 missing 加一；最后输出 left 与 missing 之和。
en: While scanning from left to right, you only need to know how many left parentheses are still unmatched, not which ones.

When a right parenthesis arrives, match it with an unmatched left one if there is any; if there is none, a left parenthesis must be inserted before it no matter what. Every left parenthesis still unmatched at the end needs one inserted right parenthesis.

Keep left (unmatched left parentheses) and missing (left parentheses that must be inserted): on a left parenthesis increase left; on a right parenthesis decrease left if it is positive, otherwise increase missing; finally print left plus missing.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain the number of unmatched left parentheses. On a right parenthesis, cancel it against a left one if there is any; otherwise insert one left parenthesis. At the end, insert right parentheses for the remaining left parentheses.

## Proof of correctness

Every right parenthesis with no left parenthesis to match must get one inserted left parenthesis, and every remaining unmatched left parenthesis must get one inserted right parenthesis; these two parts form a necessary lower bound. Inserting left parentheses immediately during the scan and right parentheses at the end produces a balanced string and reaches exactly this lower bound.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1).
